reviews.body: Found one P2 test-coverage gap in the new search endpoint. All 9 tests and the typecheck pass.

comments.body:
🟡 **P2** · 🐛 **Bug**

The new endpoint filtering and count-query logic have no regression tests: `test/search.test.ts` only checks the string returned by `containsPattern`. Those tests would still pass if this predicate stopped matching customer names or the count query lost its search filter. Add endpoint tests against Postgres covering case-insensitive partial matches on both fields, literal `%`/`_`/backslash matching, combined status/customer filters, and a multi-page result with the correct filtered `total`.
